features.contract: Declared full register composition, e.g. 512 logical qubits; exact Clifford encoding, not arbitrary-amplitude compression.
Logical quantum graph and actual intra-host FIFO descriptor transfer are separate; no physical entanglement claim.
Actual processed descriptors, payload bytes, elapsed time; original rate remains a model, not an achieved bound.
Actual bounded OS shared-memory allocations and readonly pinned leases; never allocates or infers the modelled capacity.
CPU shared-memory access is real; GPU/quantum bandwidth remains unqualified.
Supplied equal exact amplitudes normalise exactly; 36-core count remains model data, not a worker count.
Supplied Hermitian H executes exp(-iHt) exactly through existing quantum engine; no ReLU substitution.
Exact Hamiltonian sum and exact Q(phi) tensor/ReLU inference have different algorithm identities; no claimed ANE dispatch.
Executable generic intra-host transport; no Thunderbolt driver or physical rate inferred.
Bounded descriptor passing, retries, source/target identity and exact supplied operators; hardware RDMA explicitly unavailable.
Separate exact commutation and annihilation conditions, checked rather than assumed.
Exact supplied-operator commutation; does not prove actual macOS operators commute.
Content-addressed weights/programs; input/output/client data stay fresh, no silent policy learning.
Full-work admission quotas, bounded concurrency and exact requested algorithms; no mining-strategy delegation.
Real existing custody store, source/algorithm/profile-bound replay; not a substitute for canonical THESEUS/OVID qualification.

scope: Portable software contracts only. Not a claim of global whole-product closure or that physical hardware strategies have been implemented.
